`final class Rotation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.transform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Rotation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/transform/Rotation.java)

The axis of a rotation in a `Transformation`, as yaw, pitch and roll components.

## Description

`ROLL` turns the drawing in the plane of the screen; `YAW` and `PITCH` turn it in depth.
The components are read each time the rotation is applied.

### create

`Rotation create(double yaw, double pitch, double roll)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

`Rotation create(Supplier<Double> yawSupplier, Supplier<Double> pitchSupplier, Supplier<Double> rollSupplier)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

## Constant and field details

<a id="Rotation-constant-YAW"></a>

### YAW

`Rotation YAW` 

Turns around the vertical axis.

<a id="Rotation-constant-ROLL"></a>

### ROLL

`Rotation ROLL` 

Turns in the plane of the screen, around the axis that points out of it.

<a id="Rotation-constant-PITCH"></a>

### PITCH

`Rotation PITCH` 

Turns around the horizontal axis.
